Step into the late Pleistocene Epoch and survive as an early human descendant in the wild heart of ancient North America.

G - Open crafting
V - Open inventory
Z - Open skills

This game is still in active development. Bugs are expected, and data saving is still being improved. Tools currently save between joins, but are lost on death.
